Title: Login with valid email and incorrect password
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter registered email; 3. Enter incorrect password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message shown and user is not logged in
Actual Result: Your email or password is incorrect!

Title: Login with unregistered email
Preconditions: Email is not associated with any account
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter unregistered email; 3. Enter any password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Generic error identical to the wrong-password case
Actual Result: Your email or password is incorrect!
Notes: Same message observed as incorrect-password case

Title: Login with both fields empty
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Leave both fields empty; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Submission blocked and required-field prompt shown

Title: Login with invalid email format (missing @)
Preconditions: User is on the login page
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter email without @; 3. Enter any password; 4. Click Login
Expected Result: Format validation message shown before submission
Actual Result: Please include an '@' in the email address. 'testuser.com' is missing an '@'.

Title: Login with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Open login page; 2. Enter registered email; 3. Enter correct password; 4. Click Login
Test Data: Email: registered email; Password: correct password
Expected Result: User is logged in and the logged-in indicator is shown

Title: Products page displays product cards
Expected Result: Multiple product cards are visible on the page

Title: First product has name and price
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to /products page; 2. Locate first product card
Expected Result: First product displays both name and price

Title: Add product to cart and verify it appears
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products page; 2. Get first product name; 3. Click Add to Cart; 4. Navigate to cart page
Expected Result: Product appears in cart with correct name

Title: Cart product displays price and quantity
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart; 2. Navigate to cart page; 3. Check price and quantity
Expected Result: Cart item shows price and quantity >= 1

Title: Signup with new user then delete account
Test Steps: 1. Open signup page; 2. Fill signup form with new email; 3. Submit; 4. Fill account info; 5. Create account; 6. Delete account
Test Data: Email: random new email; Name: test user

Title: Signup with existing email
Test Steps: 1. Open signup page; 2. Enter existing email; 3. Submit
Expected Result: Error message shown that email already exists

Title: Remove item from cart
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart; 2. Navigate to cart; 3. Click remove button

Title: Add two different products to cart
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to products; 2. Add first product; 3. Add second product; 4. Navigate to cart

Title: Search for existing product
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to home page; 2. Enter product name in search; 3. Click search
Test Data: Search term: existing product name (e.g. 'Blue Top')

Title: Search for nonexistent product
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to home page; 2. Enter nonexistent term in search; 3. Click search
Expected Result: No results shown or empty results message

Title: Logout after login
Test Steps: 1. Login with valid credentials; 2. Click Logout link
Expected Result: User is logged out and redirected to login page

Title: Checkout while logged out requires login
Preconditions: Product in cart and user logged out
Test Steps: 1. Add product to cart (logged out); 2. Navigate to cart; 3. Click Proceed to Checkout
Expected Result: User is redirected to login page or shown login modal

Title: Checkout while logged in shows address and review
Preconditions: Product in cart and user logged in
Test Steps: 1. Login; 2. Add product to cart; 3. Navigate to cart; 4. Click Proceed to Checkout
Expected Result: Checkout page shows delivery address and order review
